note: Set A correctly extracts critical title block metadata (Lot Number, Team Name, Address, Copyright) which Set B completely ignores. Set A contains one hallucinated condition ('direction E' for slope) and one attribute error (identifying thinset as tile material), while Set B contains misbindings (assigning PT1 to the floor instead of the curb, and Edge Strip to Laundry Millwork instead of Backsplash) along with significant redundancy. Set A is preferred for its completeness and better handling of document metadata.
